sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved automation startup speed and browser connection handling.
Improved Tailed Beast Start, Stop, and maintenance flow.
Improved Card Synthesis detection and Auto All handling.
Improved license verification and app responsiveness.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed overlapping Tailed Beast Start and maintenance operations.
Fixed Card Synthesis incorrectly counting recipe slots as available cards.
Improved handling of synthesis states with insufficient cards.
